steps.title: Relative clauses: dont and lequel forms
steps.body: A2 introduced qui for the subject, que for a direct object, and où for a place or time. Add dont when the missing phrase would begin with de: le service dont j'ai besoin (avoir besoin de). After a preposition, use lequel or an agreeing form such as auquel, à laquelle, duquel. Choose the form based on the role of the missing phrase, not just on the noun's English translation. If the reference is unclear, repeat the noun instead of forcing a pronoun.

steps.title: Relative clauses: dont and lequel forms
rows: Le logement qui se trouve près du métro est libre.
The home that is near the metro is available.
Voici le service dont j'ai besoin.
Here is the service I need.
Le critère auquel je pense est le trajet.
The criterion I am thinking of is the commute.

steps.prompt: J'ai besoin de ce service. C'est le service ___ j'ai besoin.
steps.explain: Avoir besoin de requires dont in the relative clause.

steps.prompt: Je pense à ce critère. C'est le critère ___ je pense.
steps.explain: Penser à is followed by auquel for a masculine singular noun.

steps.prompt: Which form is the subject of se trouve?
steps.explain: The relative pronoun is the subject of se trouve.
